_source: Lignum, Bemessungsbeispiele zur Norm SIA 265:2021 (Ausgabe 2022), ExternalFiles/000-Normes/Litteratur/Lignum-Bemessungsbeispiele-SIA265.pdf (PDF page = printed page); Lignum Holzbautabellen HBT1 2021 (DE), ExternalFiles/000-Normes/Litteratur/Lignum-HBT-DE-2021.pdf (printed page = PDF page - 1); reference templates in ExternalFiles/201-excelTools/ («beam pre-design» template, «round column» template).
_note: Oracles for the SIA 265 chapter 4.2 member checks. Every value of the book was read off a page render (PDF -> PNG), not only off pypdf text. Book values are as printed: the book rounds every intermediate line and computes the next line FROM THE ROUNDED value, usually to 3 significant digits (stresses 2 decimals N/mm2, coefficients 3 decimals for kc/km, 2 for k and lambda_rel, lambda 3 sig. digits, section moduli 3 sig. digits x 10^6). Compare with a tolerance of about 1 in the last printed digit (or ~1 %). Template values are Excel's cached values at full precision (compare tightly). Keys: stresses/strengths N/mm2 (no suffix = N/mm2 for sigma/tau/f), lengths mm, forces kN, moments kNm, W mm3, I mm4, A mm2. All book cases are moisture class 1 (eta_w = 1.0) and use SIA 265 design strengths from Tabelle 8/9 (Tabelle 265.8/265.9 in the book). Values, symbols and page references only; no text of the sources is reproduced.

conventions.lambda_rel_exact: (265.34) lambda_rel = lambda/pi * sqrt(f_c,0,k / E_0,05) with E_0,05 of SIA 265 Anhang B (C24: 21 / 7400) -- book p. 122, 124.
conventions.lambda_rel_simplified: (265.35) lambda/57 for solid timber, (265.36) lambda/60 for glulam; the book uses 60 for GL24h on p. 131, 133 and notes lambda/57 for C24 on p. 122 (2.0) and 125 (2.25).
conventions.k_c: k = 0.5*(1 + beta_c*(lambda_rel - 0.3) + lambda_rel^2), k_c = 1/(k + sqrt(k^2 - lambda_rel^2)), beta_c 0.2 solid, 0.1 glulam.
conventions.k_h: Glulam f_m,d is multiplied by k_h (SIA 265 3.4.2.3): 1.05 at h=360 (p. 132), 1.08 at h=280 (p. 87), 1.0 at h=1400 (p. 143); HBT M_Rd for GL24h 140/400 and 120/320 contain k_h = (600/h)^0.1 (p. 39, 58). Solid timber: no k_h. Tension f_t,0,d of glulam is used WITHOUT k_h (p. 304, 310).
conventions.eta_w: All book examples are moisture class 1, so eta_w = 1 multiplies strengths only and never shows. E_0,05 in lambda_rel is used unmodified. For deflection the book writes E_m = eta_w * E_m,mean (p. 115, 135).
conventions.shear: tau_d = 1.5*V/(b*h) on the gross section (p. 73, 87, 114, 153); p. 153 reduces V at the support of a tapered beam: V_phi = V*cos(phi), phi = (alpha+beta)/2.
conventions.torsion: W_T = b^2*h/(3*eta_2), I_T = b^3*h/3*eta_1 with the book's own Tabelle 6.1-1 (h/b = 1..12, linear interpolation; at h/b 2.75: eta_1 0.764, eta_2 1.274), taken from its reference [6.4], NOT from SIA 265 -- p. 110, 113. Check (25): tau_tor,d/f_v,d + (tau_v,d/f_v,d)^2 <= 1 with f_v,d for both, p. 114.
conventions.biaxial_bending: (265.14) linear sum sigma_m,y,d/f_m,y,d + sigma_m,z,d/f_m,z,d <= 1, no 0.7 factor (p. 166, 167).
conventions.bending_compression: (265.37) sigma_c,0,d/(k_c*f_c,0,d) + sigma_m,d/(k_m*f_m,d) <= 1, linear, with k_c of the axis the moment bends about (p. 132).
conventions.compression_angle: Book uses the JOINT formula (265.113), SIA 265 6.9.1.2: f_c,alpha,d = 0.8*f_c,0,d*f_c,90,d / (0.8*f_c,0,d*sin^2 + f_c,90,d*cos^2), with f_c,90,d chosen from Tabelle 8 (1.8 generally, 2.3 with Vorholz) -- p. 269, 270, 272, 273. This may differ from the member formula of 4.2; check which one the command implements.
conventions.bending_angle: Tapered edge: sigma_m,alpha,d = sigma_m,d/cos^2(alpha) and f_m,alpha,d = f_c,90,d/(f_m,d*sin^2 + f_c,90,d*cos^2) * f_m,d (265.17) with f_c,90,d 2.7 (GL28c with Vorholz) -- p. 154, 155.
conventions.compression_perp: Two methods in the book: (a) Tabelle 8 f_c,90,d categories (generell / mit Vorholz / mit grösseren Eindrückungen) times the contact area, no k_c,90 (p. 263-266, 269, 273); (b) SIA 265 Anhang C (265.137)-(265.139): l_ef = l + min(30; v_left; l; 0.5*l1) + min(30; v_right; l; 0.5*l1), A_ef = b*l_ef, F_c,90,Rd = A_ef*k_c,90*f_c,90,d with f_c,90,d of Tabelle 50 (GL28c 1.7, GL28h 1.8) and k_c,90 1.75 (glulam, larger indentations accepted, l1 >= 2h) or 1.0 (p. 144, 278, 283).
conventions.tension_net: Net section A = t*(h - n*d) (Figur 28, 6.1.1.8); one-sided members (side pieces, Brettstrebe) take 2/3*f_t,0,d (6.1.1.10) -- p. 296, 353, 365.
conventions.template_Stuetze_Rechteck_3.12: «rectangular column» template (labelled SIA 265 (2012)): EMPTY template, no inputs and no cached results -> no case. Formulas: lambda_rel EXACT = lambda/pi*sqrt(f_c,0,k/E_0,05) with E_0,05 = 2/3*E_0,mean for solid (7333 for C24, not 7400) and 5/6*E_0,mean for glulam; k with beta_c and lambda_rel,0 = 0.3 via MAX(0, lambda_rel - 0.3); k_c = MIN(1/(k+sqrt(k^2 - MAX(lambda_rel,0.3)^2)), 1); compression check only if lambda <= 150; eta_w,T multiplies f_c,0,d and f_m,d, eta_w,S is computed but NOT used on E_0,05; lambda_rel,m = 1.15*sqrt(a*h)/b*sqrt(f_m,k/E_0,05) (exact, same E_0,05) and k_m three-branch (0.75 / 1.4); k_h: 1 for solid, max(min((600/h)^0.1, 1.1), 1) for softwood glulam, min((600/h)^0.1, 1.1) for hardwood glulam; interaction (37) linear: sigma_c/(k_c*f_c,0,d*eta_w) + sigma_m/(k_m*k_h*f_m,d*eta_w).
conventions.template_Unterzuege_1.9: «beam pre-design» template (SIA 265 (2012)): M_Rd = k_h*W*f_m,d, k_h = 1 for C24 and max(min((600/h)^0.1,1.1),1) for GL; V_Rd = A*f_v,d/1.5 (i.e. tau = 1.5 V/A); V_Ed reduced to V_Ed - q_d*h (the shear at distance h from the support); no eta_w (moisture class 1 implied); f_m,d/f_v,d from its own table (C24 14.1/1.5, GL24k 16/1.8, GL28k 18.7/1.8, GL32k 21.3/1.8).
conventions.template_Sparren_2.0: «rafter» template (SIA 265 (2021)), empty: sigma = M/(b*(h-t)^2/6) and tau = 1.5*V/(b*(h-t)) on the section net of the Kerve t; f_m,d and f_v,d times eta_w for strength (1/0.8/0.6) and E times eta_w for stiffness (1/0.9/0.75); no k_h even for GL.
conventions.template_Decken_7.02: «floor» template (SIA 265:2012), empty: web check sigma_m/(f_m,d*eta_w) + (sigma_c/(f_c,0,d*eta_w))^2 (squared compression term, as SIA (22)) or + sigma_t/(f_t,0,d*eta_w) linear for tension.
conventions.template_Rund_1.1: «round column» template: lambda_rel exact, clamped to >= 0.3, E_0,05 = 2/3*E_0,mean for round softwood (C24 7333.33); interaction sigma_c/(k_c*f_c,0,d*eta_w) + sigma_m/(f_m,d*eta_w) with no k_m and no k_h.
conventions.template_Brand_Knicken_4J1: «fire, buckling» template: fire design only (residual section, k_fi); lambda_rel = sqrt(f_c,0,k/sigma_crit), sigma_crit = pi^2*E_0,05/lambda^2, beta_c from the section family. Not used as a cold oracle.
